rule: S_N must not be null
rationale: S_N is the primary join key linking to Cust_Bio_dirty and serves as the unique record identifier; missing values would break referential integrity

rule: S_N must be unique across the table
rationale: Evidence shows value '3' appears twice (96.7% uniqueness), indicating duplicate records for a key that should uniquely identify individuals

rule: S_N must exist in Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N
rationale: S_N is designated as a one-to-one shared key with Cust_Bio_dirty; every account record must have a corresponding bio record

rule: Account_No must not be null
rationale: Account_No is the business identifier for customer accounts; missing values prevent account lookup and reconciliation

rule: Account_No must be exactly 4 digits
rationale: Sample shows consistent 4-digit numeric format (1001-1028); deviations indicate data entry errors or type conversion issues

rule: Account_No should be unique (flag duplicates for review)
rationale: Account numbers typically uniquely identify accounts; evidence shows duplicates ('1001', '1010') that require clarification as legitimate reopenings or errors

rule: Full_Name must not be null
rationale: Full name is a mandatory identity attribute for customer communication and regulatory compliance

rule: Full_Name words must start with uppercase (except lowercase particles: bin, binte, d/o, s/o)
rationale: Evidence shows case deviations: 'junrong', 'irfan', 'Hui Min tan', 'Lee yixuan' should be title-cased per the dominant pattern; particles like s/o and d/o are correctly lowercase

check_params.logic: any(w[0].islower() for w in str(row['Full_Name']).split() if w.lower() not in ('bin', 'binte', 's/o', 'd/o') and len(w) > 1)

rule: ID must not be null
rationale: Singapore NRIC/FIN is a mandatory unique identifier for legal and KYC purposes

rule: ID must follow Singapore NRIC/FIN format: letter (S/T/F/G) + 7 digits + checksum letter
rationale: 96.7% of values follow the 9-character standard format (e.g., S8403757E); 3.3% show truncated 7-character format (S123456) requiring validation

rule: JoinDate must not be null
rationale: Evidence shows 3.3% missing values (1 record); join date is essential for subscription lifecycle and tenure calculations

rule: JoinDate must be a parseable datetime string
rationale: Evidence contains unparseable value '2025-13-01' (invalid month 13) that prevents type conversion to datetime64

rule: JoinDate must not be in the future
rationale: Evidence shows future date '2027-01-15' which is likely a data entry error (typo for 2017 or 2021)

rule: JoinDate must be on or before LastLogin
rationale: Business logic: account creation must precede or equal the last login timestamp; sample shows violations where LastLogin (2019-01-01) precedes JoinDate (2020-11-02)

rule: LastLogin must not be null
rationale: Last login timestamp is critical for churn analysis and activity tracking; no missing values observed but mandatory for business logic

rule: LastLogin must be a parseable datetime string
rationale: Column is stored as string with intended type datetime64; must validate format consistency (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS)

rule: Subscription_Type must not be null
rationale: Subscription tier is a core business attribute for revenue classification; no missing values observed but required for all accounts

rule: Subscription_Type must be one of the valid tier values
rationale: Domain constraint: only five subscription tiers are valid in the system

rule: SubscriptionFee must be parseable as a numeric value
rationale: Column stored as string with intended type float64; evidence shows text value 'free' that cannot be parsed as numeric

rule: SubscriptionFee must not contain sentinel values indicating missing/invalid data
rationale: Evidence shows '99999' (100x larger than next valid value) and 'free' (text in numeric field) used as placeholders for missing or special cases

rule: If Subscription_Type is 'Free', SubscriptionFee must be 0 or NULL
rationale: Business logic: Free tier subscriptions should not incur charges; non-zero fees for Free tier indicate billing errors

check_params.logic: row['Subscription_Type'] == 'Free' and pd.to_numeric(row['SubscriptionFee'], errors='coerce') != 0 and not pd.isna(pd.to_numeric(row['SubscriptionFee'], errors='coerce'))

rule: If Subscription_Type is not 'Free', SubscriptionFee must be numeric and greater than 0
rationale: Business logic: Paid tiers must have a positive subscription fee; null, zero, or non-numeric values indicate data quality issues

check_params.logic: row['Subscription_Type'] != 'Free' and (pd.isna(pd.to_numeric(row['SubscriptionFee'], errors='coerce')) or pd.to_numeric(row['SubscriptionFee'], errors='coerce') <= 0)

rule: Status must not be null
rationale: Account status is required for active/inactive segmentation; no missing values observed

rule: Status must use the dominant boolean representations True or False
rationale: Column intended as bool but contains mixed string encodings; restrict to observed valid values pending standardization to True/False

rule: AccountBalance must not contain sentinel value 99999.0
rationale: Evidence identifies 99999.0 as a statistical outlier 100x larger than normal range, consistent with sentinel coding for missing/invalid data

rule: AccountBalance must not be negative (unless overdrafts are explicitly permitted)
rationale: Evidence shows predominantly positive balances with single negative value (-150.5) flagged as sign-anomalous; requires verification as either valid overdraft or error

rule: PreferredLanguage must not be null
rationale: Language preference is required for localized communication; no missing values observed

rule: PreferredLanguage must be a supported language option
rationale: Domain constraint: system supports five official languages

rule: Device must not be null
rationale: Device type is required for platform analytics and UX optimization; no missing values observed

rule: Device must be a valid device category
rationale: Domain constraint: only three device types are tracked in the system

rule: OS must not be null
rationale: Operating system is required for technical support and compatibility tracking; no missing values observed

rule: OS must be a valid operating system name with official casing
rationale: Evidence shows casing inconsistencies (android, IOS, LINUX, macOs); enforce canonical brand spellings

rule: FeedbackScore must be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive
rationale: Domain constraint: paired with FeedbackScore1 (range 1.0-5.0) and 81% value resemblance indicates 5-point scale; 7.3 is an outlier violating the scale maximum

rule: FeedbackScore1 must be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive
rationale: Domain constraint: observed values range from 1.0 to 5.0 consistent with a 5-point rating scale; values outside this range are invalid

rule: ID must exactly match ID_No in Cust_Bio_dirty for the same S_N
rationale: S_N is a one-to-one join key; the government ID number must be consistent across both tables for the same individual to ensure identity integrity

check_params.semantic_check: Values in Acc_Info_dirty.ID must exactly match corresponding values in Cust_Bio_dirty.ID_No for records with matching S_N

rule: Name patronymics must match Gender from Cust_Bio_dirty: Bin/s/o indicates Male, Binte/d/o indicates Female
rationale: Malay (Bin/Binte) and Indian (s/o/d/o) naming conventions encode gender in particles; inconsistencies with the Gender field indicate data entry errors

check_params.semantic_check: If Full_Name contains 'Bin' or 's/o', Gender must be 'Male'; if Full_Name contains 'Binte' or 'd/o', Gender must be 'Female' (case-insensitive match on Gender)

rule: FeedbackScore must not contain sentinel placeholder values
rationale: Profiler detected [7.3] as statistically outlying sentinel-coded value(s) in FeedbackScore.
